catalog.purpose: Broad C/C++/Fortran runtime workloads, regression cases and CTMark compile-time diagnostics.
qualification_gaps: External suites and inputs are not included merely because the CMake adapter exists.
Each benchmark requires a license, liveness check, input set, oracle and runtime contract.
CTMark is a compile-time diagnostic; do not double-count those same program families in the runtime aggregate.
catalog.size_basis: Measured HTTP response body and SHA256; logical size sums regular archive file entries, excluding filesystem allocation, submodule payloads and external datasets.
